summary: Iteration 18 — Phase 1 admin panel (SEO + Front-page content editors). Comprehensive backend + frontend testing. All 9 pytest cases pass and all 10 Playwright UI checks pass. Site-content endpoints, admin auth (localStorage token 'he_admin_token_v1'), 5 SEO editors, 3 content editors, propagation to public homepage (document.title + hero H1), hidden admin nav on public site, and logout flow — all functioning correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1380 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, vacancies, site_content, applications) for maintainability.
GET /api/site-content/{key} returns 404 for unknown keys, but PUT returns 400 for the same case — minor inconsistency; both should probably be 404 semantically.
DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT is a module-level dict but the PUT handler filters to allowed keys via set(...) on every request — negligible perf, but could be pre-computed.
seed_data_creation: None. Test writes to site_content were cleaned up via PUT { value: {} } to reset to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 admin panel is stable. When Phase 2 (job posts / poster banner / offer grid / image uploads) lands, add corresponding tests. Admin token key: 'he_admin_token_v1' in localStorage. Testids: admin-login-page, admin-login-email, admin-login-password, admin-login-submit, admin-home, admin-card-seo, admin-card-content, admin-nav-seo, admin-nav-content, admin-logout, editor-seo:<page>, editor-seo:<page>-<field>, editor-seo:<page>-save, editor-content:<key>, editor-content:<key>-<field>, editor-content:<key>-save, hero-heading. Login response uses field 'access_token' (fallback 'token' also supported in test).
